basic_info.description: 👋 I'm Dhanvi Kashyap. I am a Computer Science Student at the University of Pittsburgh, deeply interested in the power of data and its potential to drive intelligent, meaningful solutions. Whether through academic research or industry experience, I’m eager to collaborate on projects that apply advanced data techniques to create meaningful, user-centered solutions and contribute to the future of technology.
